valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the market capitalisation does not match the last price: it implies 14 per share against a market price of 1400. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so all are withheld. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
